intro: Lesson 5: Amazing towers around the world. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Minarets
points: A minaret is a masjid tower
The adhan is called from high up

blocks.text: Draw each tower next to its city and colour the continents.

keywords.def: a flat picture of all the land and sea on Earth
a very large area of land
a land with its own name and leaders
a tower of a masjid where the adhan is called

questions.q: Which country is the Burj Khalifa in?
Why is the adhan called from a minaret?
questions.a: So people far away can hear it

questions.q: Core: Draw a dot on the world map for three towers and label them.
questions.a: Dots in France, Italy and the United Arab Emirates (or Canada) with labels

questions.q: Extend: Write the continent next to each tower.
questions.a: Europe, Europe, Asia (North America for the CN Tower)

questions.q: Stretch: Why might people build very tall towers?
questions.a: To look out, to call the adhan, to show skill, or for offices and homes
A) France. It is in Paris, the capital of France.

questions.a: To see far, be seen, call the adhan far and wide, or fit more rooms on less land
